title: HOURGLASS PROTOCOL
author: Tyrin B.
desc:
YOU WANT A SLIM WAIST AND A FAT ASS?
Well, this program is designed to help with that, the aim of this program is to help with attaining an hourglass shaped physique many strive for.  By putting a lot of focus on building the shoulders, back and legs, we’ll be able to carve out a pretty good shape for an hourglass physique.  That said, this is still going to be a full body program, I don’t care how much bench press sucks how much squatting sucks, you’re gonna do it.

ex.note: Don’t be afraid to go heavy on these, your low back is not made of paper mache, and the heavy loading will help w hamstring and glute growth
8-12 for each leg
AMRAP = As Many Reps As Possible, so go until you literally cannot do another rep, also, seated or lying leg curl doesn’t really matter, focusing on letting the knee extend fully on the way up
If you can’t do these, honestly just do Bulgarians, they may suck but they’ll get the job done
Make sure the incline is at 30-45 degrees to keep the focus on upper chest, any higher will involve more tricep and front delt
Just Push Hard, super simple
Be really controlled on the eccentric of this movement, let the chest get a good stretch then hug that god damn teddy bear at the top of the rep
Let the working side arm come further across the body at the bottom to emphasize the stretch on the side delt, focusing on pushing elbows and thumbs up and out at the same time on the way up
If you don’t have a machine for these, set up a bench at an incline of 45-60 degrees and use dumbbells with the bench supporting your chest
If you struggle w depth, put plates under your heels for greater knee flexion making the squat more quad focused, also use the pad if it hurts your neck
If you’re trying to maximize quad gains get the knees to the chest
Can’t have big legs if you’re missing that inner thigh
HAHAHA SUPERSET TIME GET READY TO DIE
Hold on to something with one of your hands to help balance yourself as you descend into the squat, if you can’t get your hamstrings to your calves, slowly progress the ROM
If you find your arms coming too far forward at the bottom, try facing your body away from the cable stack
Use an EZ-Bar for these (the curved bar) and really let the elbows bend to stretch that tricep, also don’t hit your fucking head, I admire the dedication tho
Keep the incline around 60-75 degrees, cause if it’s too low this becomes less of a curl and more of a contortion
LET THEM ELBOWS BEND AND THROW SOME WEIGHT AROUND
Since we’re using dumbbells don’t be afraid to throw around a little more weight than you would with cables
If doing these standing is a little tough on your lower back, sit down, simple fix
